scope: first five coupled Newton updates, plus the second solve final update; frozen Sentaurus pre-states, not independent Vela scan history

configuration.physics: Fermi, OldSlotboom, Masetti/Enormal/HFS(GradQuasiFermi), SRH(DopingDep), self-consistent avalanche; Band2Band off
configuration.vela_build: UCRT64 C++20 Release -O3 -DNDEBUG; direct_bordered Eigen SparseLU; HDF5, UMFPACK and SPQR available

normalization: physical psi/fn/fp/electrode volts; exact carrier and contact-psi constraint elimination; b/Jii using each transformed operator, identical L2/RMS/Linf. This diagnostic does not calibrate RhsMin.
conversion_scope: Common high-accuracy Fermi integral and native Nc/Nv, with simultaneous dpsi included; NewtonPlot did not export actual e/h QF fields, so no bitwise claim for native internal QF reconstruction.
notes: Primary arms match all 2152 silicon populations and all 2600 potentials. Earlier free-node-only controls are superseded and excluded.
Each C++ run extracts one Newton step with an intentionally one-step budget and strict diagnostic tolerances; budget-exhausted is expected and is not a convergence result.
A same-state replay does not establish the unique cause of Vela own-sweep failure.
